The Invisible Revenue Leak

The leak is not your lead generation.
It's what happens after the lead arrives.

You already paid for the inquiry. It only becomes revenue if somebody acts on it. Missed leads don't fail loudly — they just vanish. No call. No viewing. No deal. No commission.

You already have a CRM. Good — keep it. PRT Circle isn't a replacement, it's the layer that runs alongside it and catches exactly what it can't: the moment before a lead ever gets logged.

FAQ

A few things worth clarifying.

Does it work with Property Finder, Bayut and Dubizzle?

The system is configured around the inquiry format available from your portal and inbox workflow, including all three.

What happens if an inquiry format changes?

Parsing and extraction rules are tested and maintained against your actual inbound formats.

Does it automatically contact buyers?

No. The system alerts the responsible broker. Human contact stays entirely under your brokerage's control.

How long until the engine pays for itself?

On a single AED 25M villa at 5% commission, one recovered deal is AED 1,250,000 — well over 100x the implementation cost. Most brokerages only need one previously-lost inquiry to convert for the engine to have paid for itself. Use the ROI calculator above with your own numbers rather than taking our word for it.

We already use Salesforce or HubSpot.

Good — keep it. The Engine isn't a CRM and doesn't compete with one. It handles the part before a lead ever reaches your CRM: capturing the inquiry, matching it to a property, scoring it, and alerting the broker in real time on WhatsApp. A lead sitting unopened in a Salesforce queue is exactly the failure mode this exists to close.

Is our data secure?

Your brokerage owns its data outright. It lives inside your own Notion workspace, not a shared multi-tenant database, and automation runs through your own connected Make.com account. Nothing is pooled with other clients. Full detail is in the Security & Data section above.

Who owns the lead?

You do, entirely. Every lead record lives in your own Notion workspace from the moment it's captured. PRT Circle configures and maintains the system but holds no ownership claim over your leads, your buyer data, or your pipeline — it's yours before, during, and after the engagement.

What is the monthly retainer actually for, and why does it matter?

It keeps your engine current as your business grows — new portal formats, new brokers added, new WhatsApp templates, and a direct line to the person who built it whenever you need a change. Brokerages that skip ongoing maintenance are the ones that find their automation silently broken six months in, at exactly the wrong moment. The retainer is what keeps this an asset instead of a liability.

Does my team need to learn a new system?

No. Brokers keep working exactly as they do now — alerts arrive on WhatsApp, the app they already have open all day. There is no new dashboard to log into and no training required for day-to-day use. Only whoever reviews the Notion pipeline needs a short walkthrough, covered in handover.
